body:
Adds `research/verifier-league` (stdlib-only, 11 tests, whitepaper, experiments), extending `forecast-duel` from two verifiers to n.

- Pairwise e-process rate is `KL(q‖midpoint)`; the binding rival is the one whose midpoint with the leader is nearest q, i.e. the best opposite-side rival, not the runner-up.
- Mixture certifies within 1.35–1.60× the oracle delay; elimination cuts verifier evaluations 4–5× at n=8–12; peeking z-tests declare a false best in 59% of tie runs vs 1.6%.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
